description: Contains an error type 'AsyncWaitTimeoutError' and an asynchronous utility function 'waitUntil' for waiting with a timeout until a condition becomes true.

classes.name: AsyncWaitTimeoutError
classes.description: An error type representing a timeout during an asynchronous wait operation.

methods.name: waitUntil
methods.description: An asynchronous function that waits until a specified condition returns true or a timeout occurs.
